name: Texas
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Texas's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): El Paso in the west, Brownsville at the mouth of the Rio Grande in the south, the panhandle in the north, the Sabine in the east. Open Gulf beyond Brownsville and the Sabine Pass is trimmed; the Gulf off the coast between them inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle, and the box takes in parts of Mexico, New Mexico, Oklahoma and Louisiana. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-tx.
